purpose: Document city-scope registry evidence and bounded public parcel-geometry route review.
assessment: Local city survey and registration offices are verified. Karnataka/DILRMP land-record services are record workflows, and the public pages reviewed did not expose anonymous full parcel polygons.
registryAssessment: Kalaburagi’s official district administration lists the city DDLR/land-records office and district registrar and links its Revenue services to Bhoomi land records. A Karnataka Legislative Council government reply lists an Assistant Director of Land Records City Survey, Kalaburagi and a Kalaburagi Sub-Registrar Office. This city-specific office evidence confirms registry/survey activity; the district-level modernization tables do not prove city parcel coverage.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Kalaburagi’s official district administration lists the city DDLR/land-records office and district registrar and links its Revenue services to Bhoomi land records. A Karnataka Legislative Council government reply lists an Assistant Director of Land Records City Survey, Kalaburagi and a Kalaburagi Sub-Registrar Office. This city-specific office evidence confirms registry/survey activity; the district-level modernization tables do not prove city parcel coverage.

The Government of Karnataka district portal lists the Deputy Director of Land Records at Mini Vidhan Soudh, Kalaburagi, District Registrar Department and the Bhoomi land-record service. A state legislative answer names an Assistant Director of Land Records City Survey Kalaburagi and the city Sub-Registrar Office. DILRMP public pages report status at Kalaburagi district/taluk scope; they are status tables, not geometry. No owner/plot lookup was run and no safe feature schema was found.
